label: PF Backlog 189
title: Backend: reconcile model-tier drift (model ids not in registry + stage keys)
body:
## Problem / why
`python scripts/dev/wired_audit.py` (advisory) reports 17 model ids used in `config/model-tier.json`
that are NOT in the model registry, plus 2 stage-key drifts (`[actual]`, `[actual-balanced]` reference
stage `4`). Non-fatal, but causes silent model fallbacks / resolution surprises.

## Goal & value
Reconcile the tier model ids + stage keys with the registry so `tier-models` reports 0 drift.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- `wired_audit` tier-models advisory: 0 model-id drift and 0 stage-key drift (or an explicit allow).

## Out of scope
- Model catalog contents/pricing (BI-0173). Auto tier policy (BI-0174).

## Verification / test plan
- `python scripts/dev/wired_audit.py` clean on the tier-models advisory; pipeline still resolves models.

dashboard_impact.reason: Internal/data-quality fix; no dashboard/UI behaviour change.

_note: config/model-tier.json reconciled: remapped 14 free-trial + 3 free-trial-fast OpenRouter ids to registry-known free models (deepseek-v4-flash-free/mimo-v2.5-free/hy3-free/nemotron-3-ultra-free/nemotron-3.5-lightning-free/laguna-s-2.1-free); removed invalid stage key 4 (valid are 4-0/4a..4f) from base + actual-balanced. check_tier_models + wired_audit: tier-models 0 drift. Backup: Temp/opencode/model-tier.backup-*.json
